highlights: Early & Rapid Warcry (Lv10, 60s CD): Shares your single active WAR stance (Berserk, Defender, Aggressor, Retaliation, or Restraint) with the party.
Tactical Breach (Lv10, 20s CD, 10s, Enemy 15y): +12/18/24/30% Skillchain DMG, +8/12/16/20% Magic Burst & Crit DMG, +100/150/200/250 TP on SC close.
Formation: Bulwark (Lv10, 25s CD, 15s, Party 10y): Stacking Phalanx (8 + 0.45*Lv), +5/10/15/20 MDEF, +12/18/25/35 Status Resist, +30/50/75/100% Knockback Resist.
Battle Cadence (Lv10, 20s CD, 12s, Party 10y): +12/18/24/30 Subtle Blow (+0/0/5/10 SB II), +10/15/22/30 Conserve TP, +8/12/16/20% Cure Rcvd.
Rallying Horn (Lv10, 45s CD, 12s, Party 12y): Cleanses Slow/Bind (Lv30+ Weight/Para; Lv50+ DEF/MDEF Down; Lv70+ Atk/Acc Down), +5/7/9/12% HP, +75/125/175/250 TP, +8/10/12/15% Move Speed.
souls.lore: A seasoned war-captain whose rallying cries and battlefield formations turn scattered adventurers into an ironclad company.
souls.summary: Active battlefield tactician (Lv10+): weaves short-cooldown party & mark JAs that scale stronger as you level (Lv10/30/50/70+), shares your active WAR stance with Warcry, and trades swing uptime for JA animation locks.

highlights: Twin Executioner Axes (Lv10+): Dual-wield two separate Great Axes via the native Equipment menu (compact 1H axe visuals, balanced main/offhand damage, delay, TP, and main-only multi-attack).
Passives (Lv10/30/50+): +8/12/16% Attack, +6/10/14% Double Attack, +5/8/12% WS Damage, +5/10/15 Store TP.
Bloodlust Surge (Lv10, 25s CD, 10s, Self): +10/14/18/24% Attack% and +15/22/30/40% Double Attack Damage at -10% DEF%.
Savage Cleave (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 4y): Overstraining physical strike (0 TP gained) that inflicts 6/8/10/12% Max HP recoil.
Berserk: +10% extra Attack%, +60s duration, and instantly grants +300 TP on activation.
Aggressor: Removes -25 Evasion penalty and grants +5% Critical Hit Rate.
Blood Rage: +10% extra Critical Hit Rate and +15s duration.
Warcry: +8% extra Attack% potency.
souls.lore: A storm of untamed martial fury who surrenders caution to the roar of battle, cleaving through ranks with primal ferocity.
souls.summary: Unrelenting fury (Lv10+): amplifies Berserk, Blood Rage, and Warcry with heavy Attack, Double Attack, and WSD.

highlights: Phalanx Spear & Buckler Mastery: +15/25/35/50 Polearm & Shield skill, +10/16/22/28% Block Rate, +15/25/35/45 Shield TP. Real Size-1 Buckler: +10% Block and Iron Resolve cap 40% Max HP; empty SUB: 10% virtual Aspis Buckler block.
Spartan's Grit: taking damage or blocking grants +1 Grit (max 5). Any Polearm WS consumes all Grit for an Iron Resolve barrier (4/5/6/7% Max HP per stack, cap 35%/40%), heavy enmity, and Maim.
Impaling Thrust (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 8y, Polearm): Stun 2s (+5s Silence mid-cast), Maim, +2 Grit (+4 during Defender / Mighty Strikes).
Phalanx Ward (Lv10, 35s CD, 2 Grit, Self 12s, Polearm): +15/22/30/38% Block, -10/12/15/18% DT, +25/35/45/55 Enmity, Knockback Immunity, arms a Heavy Brace.
Spear-Wall Brace: Defender (15s CD) arms a Light Brace (-25% next hit, +1 Grit, Off-Balance). Heavy Brace: -50% next hit, Grit to 5, 2s Stun, Exposed Guard (+4s Silence vs spells).
Tactical Instinct: warns when your target crosses 750 TP or begins casting.
Tier 6 Tank: -60% Physical & Magical Damage Dealt, no negative ATTP/RATTP/WSD penalties.
WAR JAs: Warcry (party -8% DMG, +20 self Enmity, Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Provoke (Adrenaline Surge below 50% HP), Mighty Strikes (-25% DT, +50 Enmity, instant 5 Grit).
souls.lore: An unbroken spear-and-buckler stalwart forged in the discipline of the ancient phalanx, holding the line where lesser shields shatter.
souls.summary: Frontline phalanx tank (Lv10+): requires a Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (or an empty SUB for a virtual Aspis Buckler) to unlock Spear-Wall Guard/Block, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, and charge-based Melee & Spell Brace deflection.

highlights: Counter & Deflection: +15/30/50 Parry Skill, +5/10/15% Parry Rate, +12/22/30% Counter, +8/16/28 Counter DMG, +15/25/40 Enmity, -25/40/60% Enmity Loss, +6/10/15% HP, -5/8/12% DT.
Staff Riposte (w/ Staff): +12% Parry Rate; Parrying heals 2% Max HP, grants +75 TP, +Enmity, and strikes back. Evading grants 1.5% Max HP, +50 TP, +Enmity, and deals an Evasive Counter.
Iron Counterstance (Lv10, 120s CD): +30% Counter, +20 Counter DMG, -10% DT, +20 Enmity, with no DEF halving penalty.

Tank JAs: Dodge (60s, +25 EVA, +15% EVA, +12% Parry, +15 Enmity, +25% Evasive Counter DMG), Focus (+15% Counter, +15 Parry, +10 Counter DMG), Boost (+15 Enmity, +50 TP), Chi Blast (heavy Enmity + Acc Down), Chakra (+50% heal, Regen, cleanses Slow/Silence), Perfect Counter (45s CD, +25 Counter DMG, +25 Enmity, 5% heal), Mantra (party -5% DT), Inner Strength (60s, -25% DT, +20% EVA%, +30 Counter DMG, +50 Enmity).
souls.lore: A serene master of the quarterstaff and martial stillness who turns an opponent’s own momentum into poise and unshakable footing.
souls.summary: Agile staff master (Lv10+): evades and parries incoming blows with a Staff, ripostes missed or parried strikes, and anchors aggro through Counterstance.

highlights: Empty-Handed Vow: Cannot equip ANY weapon or item in Main or Sub slots (bare fists only).

Dual-Fist Chi & Boost Stacking (0-20y): Auto-attacks unleash main & off-hand Light Chi bolts (+Kick procs) and ranged H2H Weaponskills work up to 20y. Every landed bolt grants +1 Boost stack (WS +3/+4/+5, max 100, +1 Cure Pot/MACC/MAB per 5 stacks) plus light sustain pulses.
Healer Offense Tradeoff: -20% Attack% & -58% Weaponskill DMG; Light Chi bolts deal light healer chip damage in exchange for party sustain.

Custom JAs (Lv10+): Resonant Chi (20s CD, 20y Light burst + 1.75x target AoE heal & Cleanse), Tranquil Lotus (30s CD, 12y Party/Pet heal + 15s Regen, +Cure Rcvd, & Enmity-), Inner Harmony (45s CD, 18s +Cure Potency, +MAB/MACC, +Ability Haste, +Regen, & +40% Chi Bolt/Pulse power).

Healer MNK JAs: Chi Blast (5s CD, 0 damage, consumes all 0-100 Boost stacks for a massive 20y party AoE heal + up to 3 debuff cleanses), Boost (+5 Boost stacks, +50 TP & light engaged pulse), Focus (+25 MACC, +20 MAB, +15% Cure Pot), Dodge (+30 EVA, -10% DT, -25 Enmity), Chakra (projects 45% AoE heal + self cleanse), Mantra (party Regen + Cure Rcvd%), Formless Strikes (+15% Chi DMG/+20% Pulse), Hundred Fists (2x Chi Bolt speed & +25% Pulse).
souls.lore: An empty-handed mystic who draws luminous life-force from within, guiding soothing currents of chi across the fray.
souls.summary: Bare-handed Chi channeler (Lv10+): cannot equip weapons in Main or Sub slots, firing dual 20y Light Chi bolts and ranged H2H Weaponskills that stack Boost up to 100 for massive 5s-CD Chi Blast 20y party heals.

highlights: H2H Oath: Restricted strictly to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists (cannot equip Staves, Clubs, or non-H2H weapons in Main/Sub).
Martial Relentlessness: +6/10/15/20% Kick Rate, +8/15/24/35 Kick DMG, +3/5/8/12% Crit Rate, +5/9/14/20 Store TP, +5/10/15/20 Subtle Blow, +6/10/16/22% WSD.
Combo Momentum: Every Hand-to-Hand Weaponskill refunds +75 TP to sustain rapid skillchain pressure.

Aggressive JAs: Boost (+100 TP, +8% Crit & +15% next WSD), Focus (+10% Crit, +15% Crit DMG, +25 Acc), Dodge (+10% Abil Haste, +15 Subtle Blow), Chakra (+30% heal, +150 TP, cleanses Para/Blind/Weight), Chi Blast (+35% DMG, -15% DEF Down, +100 TP), Footwork (+15 Kick DMG, +10% Kick Rate, +10% Atk%), Hundred Fists (+25% Atk%, +15% Crit, +20% DA, +20 Store TP).
souls.lore: A living instrument of disciplined fist and foot, channeling lifelong temple training into a seamless tempest of strikes.
souls.summary: Pure Hand-to-Hand striker (Lv10+): restricted strictly to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists, trading weapon variety for relentless Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Crit, WSD, and TP flow.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% HP & MP, +12/18/24/32 MND & VIT, +18/26/34/42% Cure Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +4/6/8/12 MP/tick Refresh, +10/14/18/22% Shield Block (Club+Shield), 100% SIRD in Afflatus.
Proactive Afflatus Solace: Unlocked @ Lv10+ (0s CD); Cure I-VI grant Solace Ward barrier (35-50% of heal, cap 30% Max HP) + -8% DT for 8s.
Sacred Grace Smite-Weaving: Banish/Holy or Club/Staff WS grants +1 Sacred Grace (max 3) & +6% Max MP; at 3 stacks, Curaga/Esuna/Auspice triggers a 10s party Regen (15 + 2.2% Max HP/tick).
JA Enhancements: Divine Seal (20s CD, +15% Max HP barrier), Martyr & Devotion (15s CD, 0 self-HP loss), Benediction (100% party heal/cleanse + 50% MP + -25% DT 15s).
Divine Veil (25s CD, 22% HP barrier + -12% DT + +30 MEVA + splash next Cure/Erase/Esuna) & Sanctuary Pulse (20s CD, 25% HP AoE heal + 3-debuff cleanse + 1 Sacred Grace).
souls.lore: A high steward of sanctuary and solemn grace whose luminous benedictions shelter the faithful before ruin can fall.
souls.summary: Proactive Barrier-Cure & Afflatus Solace Conduit (Lv10+): converts Cure healing and overhealing into Solace Ward Stoneskin barriers, weaves Banish/Holy/Club WSs into instant 0-MP Curagas, and protects the party with Divine Veil.

highlights: Staff Communion restores MP on a damaging staff attack round, at most once every 3 seconds.
At Lv.10, use Dawnfire and Consecration. Sunbrand unlocks at Lv.30, then Pillar of Day and Last Light at Lv.50. Last Light intensifies at Lv.70.
Consecration amplifies the next damaging spell within 20 seconds, so hold it for an opening.
souls.lore: A militant crusader of sacred light who walks the frontlines with staff in hand, answering darkness with radiant conviction.
souls.summary: Fight in melee to refill MP with Staff Communion. Spend it on powerful light magic against a single enemy.

highlights: Wingmate designates one party caster within 15y. Select yourself to practice with Vigil Lance.
Valkyrie's Escort secures one retry of the exact spell after a hostile interruption. Starts within 6s.
Lv.30 unlocks an ally MP refund, Lv.50 extends Escort range and introduces a reduced self refund, and Lv.70 increases the refund.
souls.lore: A winged-spear sentinel of the sacred order who watches over vulnerable allies and steadies their resolve amidst chaos.
souls.summary: A polearm support Soul that rescues one ally after enemy damage interrupts a spell.

highlights: Lv.10: Elemental probes set Ancient Invocation alignment. Gather Aether restores MP.
Lv.30: Read the target with Elemental Survey. Lv.50: Choose from six powerful Ancient Magic spells. Lv.70: Their power increases.
Ancient resolves into 18s shared recovery. Astral Saturation reduces the unique damage bonus of allied follow-up Ancients for 20s.
souls.lore: A stargazing archmage who reads celestial alignments to call down cataclysmic astral forces upon Vana’diel’s mightiest foes.
souls.summary: Read an enemy with elemental probes and commit to one decisive, single-target Ancient Magic cast.

highlights: Lv.10: Use Conduit Link on one party caster, or self-link for a solo MP discount.
Lv.30: A successful allied cast relays 5% of its actual MP expenditure to you. Aether Tap drains enemy MP.
Later levels increase Link range and savings. Ancient Magic, instant casts and another Channeler cannot receive the allied link.
souls.lore: A selfless conduit of arcane current who binds their own aetheric flow to an ally, amplifying a fellow caster’s grandest incantations.
souls.summary: Give one ally a faster, cheaper cast by committing your own casting window.

highlights: HP +10%, Scythe Skill raised to A+, and enhanced Occult Acumen.

Undead Warrior & Dullahan (Tank Mode): Tier 6 -60% DMG Dealt (0.12x WS), 100% Thrall AoE/Conal boss immunity, 100% Master-to-Thrall single-target enmity transfer, and 80% Cure (+100% overheal) forwarding.
Undead Mage & Corse (Caster Mode / No Pet): Tier 2 Hybrid -25% DMG Dealt (0.50x WS) & -20 Enmity; ranged Dark casters that empower party DPS via Grim Incantations.
Harbinger's Drain: Scythe WSs heal Tank Thralls for 16/18/20/22% Max HP (clamp-proof) or Caster Thralls for 25-50% of WS damage.
Dark Pact: While an undead summon is alive, gain Double Attack, Store TP, and Accuracy.
Corpse Explosion: Implodes your summon onto your single engaged target for concentrated Dark damage without pulling nearby mobs.
Grim Conversion: Converts MACC->ACC, MATT->ATT, Fast Cast->Haste, and Magic Burst Bonus->WSD (Elemental Celerity unchanged).
souls.lore: A forbidden scholar of twilight and the scythe who binds restless echoes of the fallen to stand watch or whisper dark sorcery.
souls.summary: Scythe-wielding Black Mage who commands undead tank and ranged dark caster summons, drains life through weaponskills, and detonates thralls with Corpse Explosion.

highlights: Crimson Fencer Mastery (1H Sword + Empty Sub): +15/25/35/50 Sword & Enfeebling/Enhancing skill, +14/20/26/32% Parry Rate, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, and 100% Spell Interruption Rate Down.
Hex-Mitigation: reduces target physical & magical damage dealt by 5% per active enfeeble (up to -25%) and grants +3% Parry Rate per enfeeble (+15% max).
Crimson Riposte: parrying triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and restores +4% Max MP.
Barrier & WS Weaving: enhances Stoneskin (25% Max HP, 15s recast) & Phalanx (30s recast); Sword WSs grant Crimson Flow (next Enfeeble/Stoneskin/Phalanx instant, 0 MP, +50% VE).
Enhances Convert (30s CD, 50% HP floor + full Stoneskin), Composure (+30 ACC/MACC, +50% Enfeebling duration), and Chainspell (30s, -25% DT, enmity pulse).
souls.lore: An aristocratic fencer who weaves dueling elegance with subtle hexes, meeting overwhelming foes blade-to-blade with unruffled poise.
souls.summary: Frontline duelist tank (Lv10+): requires a 1H Sword with an empty off-hand to unlock Fencer Parry/Riposte mastery, Hex-Mitigation (cutting enemy damage per active enfeeble), and instant-cast Stoneskin/Phalanx barrier weaving.

highlights: Break Stride and Seize Initiative open Advance. Obscure Aim and Quiet Front open Recompose.
Lv.30 Unravel Defense repeats the last issued order. Lv.50+ a full resist can grant a half-potency order.
A new enfeeble replaces the pending order. Same-kind orders use the highest potency already active on the recipient.
souls.lore: A courtly strategist of San d’Orian and Jeunoan tradition who reads the ebb of battle to issue decisive, tailored commands.
souls.summary: Choose a useful enfeeble, then make the tactical decision of who receives your order.

highlights: Lv.10: Spellweave enters Yin and Bladeweave enters Yang. Start in Yang on activation.
Combat form changes share a 12s recast and a 2s offensive recovery. Change freely outside combat.
Lv.30/50/70 unlock stronger spells and raise the active form bonus from 15% to 18/22/25%.
souls.lore: A virtuoso of crimson duality who balances keen swordplay and refined sorcery, shifting gracefully between steel and spell.
souls.summary: Commit to one offensive form. Yin focuses elemental spell damage. Yang focuses ordinary Sword swings.

highlights: Pass the Blame unlocks at Lv.10. Position an ally between yourself and the enemy to route threat.
A damaging Dagger or Sword WS applies 5/7/9/12% Attack Down for 16s, once every 20s.
A missed WS, an immunity or existing Attack Down keeps the cooldown available. Suppression works solo.
souls.lore: A silver-tongued schemer of misdirection and sleight of hand who orchestrates the flow of attention across the battlefield.
souls.summary: Position behind the party member who should take threat, and weaken the enemy with well-timed weapon skills.

highlights: Find the Gap creates a personal opening. Existing enemy Defense Down also qualifies.
Opportunism refunds 75/100/125/150 TP on a qualified damaging weapon skill. 12s personal lockout.
Back Alley Strike prepares a positional critical attack. Both actions unlock at Lv.10.
souls.lore: A ruthless opportunist of back-alley steel who spots the faintest crack in a foe’s guard and strikes without hesitation.
souls.summary: Time a landed Dagger or Sword weapon skill to exploit a weakness and reclaim TP.

highlights: Phantom's Dare unlocks at Lv.10, adds base 180 CE / 650 VE, and arms a one-hit magic/breath guard for 6s.
Guard mitigation scales from 8% to 10/12/15%. Ordinary hits never spend it.
Genuine melee evades reinforce threat every 2s with a Dagger or Katana equipped.
souls.lore: A taunting shadow-dancer who draws every eye and blade onto themselves, slipping past danger like smoke through clenched fingers.
souls.summary: A Dagger or Katana evasion tank that opens with direct threat and maintains it as enemy swings miss.

highlights: Perpetual Majesty: Always active @ Lv10+ (0s lockout); single-target Cures splash to party (15y) at 100% potency; overhealing grants Light's Grace (15 + 2.2% Max HP/tick HoT, 10s).
Beacon of Light: Melee hits and Club WSs heal the lowest-HP ally (12y) for 8/11/14/18% PLD Max HP and restore +5% Max MP.

JA Enhancements: Divine Seal (20s CD, 2-debuff party cleanse), Chivalry (15s CD, 40% MP + 15% AoE heal), Rampart (-15% DT aura), Sanctuary Benediction (replaces Invincible: 100% party heal/cleanse + -20% DT).
Holy Radiance (20s CD, Club+Shield: 25% HP AoE heal + 2-debuff cleanse + 10% MP) & Crusader's Aegis (25s CD, 10s -15% DT + Knockback Immune + 2x Beacon).
souls.lore: A frontline hospitaller whose consecrated swings and steadfast presence bring dawn-lit solace to wounded companions in the thick of battle.
souls.summary: Frontline Holy Light & Perpetual Majesty AoE Cure Crusader (Lv10+, Club+Shield): splashes single-target Cures party-wide with Light's Grace HoTs, pulses Beacon of Light on melee/WS, and protects allies with Crusader's Aegis.

highlights: Club & Shield Mastery: +15/25/35/50 Club & Shield skill, +3/5/7/9 Shield DEF Bonus, +12/18/24/30% Block (+10% w/ Club+Shield), +20/30/40/50 Shield Mastery TP, 100% SIRD w/ Shield.

Divine Intercept: While Shield+Club equipped & >35% HP, redirects 25% of party damage within 10y (40% in Consecration) onto PLD (-20% dmg, capped at 12%/18% Max HP per hit and 30%/40% per 1.5s AoE window).
Zeal & Holy Retribution (Max 5): Blocking or intercepting grants +1 Zeal; at 5 Zeal, Flash / Shield Bash / Club WS detonates Holy Nova (+8% Max MP, party -10% DT for 8s, heavy enmity).
Club WS Engine & JAs: Club WSs scale off VIT+MND, inflict -15% ATK/MATK Down (Skullbreaker/Brainshaker), and restore party HP/MP; enhances Sentinel, Rampart, Chivalry, and Invincible.
souls.lore: An oathbound bastion of royal steel who steps willingly into harm’s path, interposing shield and sacred vow between danger and comrades.
souls.summary: Order of the Silver Aegis tank (Lv10+): requires a Club + Shield to unlock Divine Intercept (absorbing 25% of damage taken by nearby party members), Zeal stack generation on block/intercept, and Holy Retribution party auras.

highlights: Condemn increases regular Great Sword damage by 10/13/16/18% and enemy damage received by 10%.
Absolve opens retaliation after a single enemy hit costs at least 8% max HP. It provides no mitigation.
Reckoning doubles against the enemy that opened retaliation. Vows can only change outside combat.
souls.lore: A grim knight who casts aside gentle restraint for a singular, uncompromising vow of judgment carried on a heavy greatsword.
souls.summary: Commit before combat to vulnerable Great Sword pressure or a reactive retaliation vow.

highlights: Damaging enemy spells and TP moves or every sixth completed enemy melee round open five seconds of recovery.
Finality (4y) deals 1.3x normalized Scythe damage, increasing to 2.3/2.6/2.6/3.0x during recovery.
Below 25% target HP, a recovery Finality gains a further 15% at Lv.50 and 20% at Lv.70.
Grave Toll deals single-target dark damage, gaining 50% during recovery without spending Finality.
souls.lore: A patient executioner of the curved scythe who watches for a foe’s fleeting moment of vulnerability and harvests it in silence.
souls.summary: A Scythe executioner who times powerful single-target strikes as enemies recover from their own attacks.

highlights: Scythe & Dark Magic Mastery: +15/25/35/50 Scythe & Dark Magic skill, +10/14/18/22% Parry Rate (Inquartata), -20/30/40/50% Dark Magic Cast Time & 100% SIRD on Dark Magic.

Blood-Pool, Blood Tithe & Dread Spikes: Drain II (12 MP, 30s CD) scales off 12/15/18/22% Max HP + VIT (+25% Max HP overcap 30s); Absorb-STR/VIT/TP/ACC (18s shared CD, instant) restore +6% Max MP & grant +1 Blood Tithe (max 3); Dread Spikes (45s CD, no MP, 10% Current HP cost) builds 25% + 5%/Tithe Max HP shield (up to 40%).

Scythe WS Reap & Souleater: Scythe WSs heal 5/6/7/8% Max HP (10/12/14/16% w/ Drain II or Souleater; 2x in Dread Bastion), extend Drain II +6s, and inflict Cripple (-15% ATTP / -15 MATT / -20 ACC, 15s); Souleater (45s CD, 12s, -12% DT) spends 2% HP/hit for VE + Blood Tithe + Blood Reap (+20% WS heal).

JAs: Abyssal Cleave (25s CD, 2s Stun, heavy VE, Breach -15% DEF/-15 MDEF, +8% MP, +1 Blood Tithe); Dread Bastion (60s CD, 12s: -18% DT, Knockback Immune, +35 Enmity, 2s AoE VE pulses, 2x WS heal); Blood Weapon (+4% Max HP/swing, +50 Enmity, -20% DT); Arcane Circle (shared Ward -10% DMG/+25 MEVA).
souls.lore: An imposing juggernaut of dark plate and crimson resolve who drinks deeply of shadow to outlast the fiercest onslaught.
souls.summary: Abyssal blood-knight tank (Lv10+): requires a Scythe to unlock Max-HP scaled Drain II Blood-Pool overcap, Blood Tithe Absorb weaving, costed Dread Spikes barriers, and Scythe WS Blood Reap sustain.

highlights: Withering and Ash are available at Lv.10. They reduce physical TP or spell damage by 8/8/12/15% at Lv.10/30/50/70+.
Famine unlocks at Lv.30 and reduces standard enemy self-heals by 20/25/30%.
Curses share a 12-second recast and last up to 24 seconds. A resisted curse leaves any current curse active.
Dark immunity can grant an eight-second party ward at half potency for one matching hit or heal.
souls.lore: A feared hex-bearer who lays targeted maledictions upon a monster’s deadliest nature, stifling ruin before it can unfold.
souls.summary: Choose one curse to dampen a dangerous enemy action, with a short ward against explicit dark immunity.

highlights: Lv.10: Call Packmate, Set Quarry, Pack Rend and Raking Kick give the Soul a complete opening loop.
Pack Rend or landed axe and great axe weapon skills feed the hare 125/175/225/275 TP.
Landed Raking Kick returns 75/100/125/150 TP. The two links each recover in 8 seconds.
Lv.30: Rally Packmate adds a separate summon recast. Offensive scaling increases at Lv.30, 50 and 70.
souls.lore: A wild-hearted hunter who moves in primal tandem with a ferocious companion, turning master and beast into one relentless predator.
souls.summary: Fight alongside an offensive hare and trade TP as you land attacks against the same enemy.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/26% Max HP (Master & Pet), +8/14/20/26 VIT/CHR, +14/20/26/32% DEF, -12/15/18/22% Master DT (-30% Pet DT + 100% AoE/Conal immunity), +60/80/100/120 Enmity & +25-60% Retention, +15-50 Axe, +10-22% Guard/Parry, 15s Ready CD.

Tank Beast Roster (0 Jugs): Bestial Loyalty (5s CD) cycles Crab / Beetle / Tortoise / Tiger; Call Beast (15s CD, usable in combat) summons @ 100% Master level; Zero-Biscuit Reward (25s CD) heals both 20% + 2 cleanse + 12s Hybrid Regen.

Always-On 50% Soul-Link & Cure Mirroring: splits 50% Master damage to Pet (pauses <15% HP), funnels 100% Pet melee & Ready enmity to Master, mirrors 60% Cure/Waltz/Regen + 100% overheal to Pet; 1H Axe WSs heal Pet 15-25% + Cripple.

Tank-Reworked Ready Skills: grant Master +100 TP, heavy enmity, and spec utility (Crab DEF/MDT/Stoneskin/Cripple/Breach; Beetle Guard/Stun/Slow+Expose/Spoil; Tortoise DT+KB-Immune/Stun+Breach/AccDown; Tiger Para+Cripple/PackTP/Heal).

Soul Bond (35s CD): equalizes Master & Pet HP% (min +15% if within 10%) + 15% Stoneskin; Feral Roar (25s CD): 8y AoE Stun + Slow + threat +1 Ready charge; Familiar: -25% DT, +25% HP & full Ready charges (30s).
souls.lore: A fierce pack-leader who stands shoulder-to-shoulder with a loyal guardian beast, sharing every hardship through an unbreakable bond.
souls.summary: Symbiotic 1H Axe & Guardian Beast tank (Lv10+): always-on 50% Soul-Link damage split, 4 whitelisted Tank Guardian Beasts (Crab, Beetle, Tortoise, Tiger) @ 100% Master level with 0 jug/biscuit cost, Cure/Overheal mirroring, and tank-reworked Ready skills.

highlights: Lv.10: Call Tracker, Track Quarry, Read Quarry, and Expose Quarry enable targeted party support from the first fight.
Expose Quarry boosts two matching physical hits per party member at most, with a maximum of one claim per attack round.
Known family bonus scales to 8/10/10/12%. Unknown family yields 4/4/4/6%. Exposure lasts 8 seconds, or 10 from Lv.50.
Lv.30: Observe the quarry’s latest completed hostile action after a read. Lv.50: Choose Weakness overrides the next exposure type.
souls.lore: A keen naturalist of Vana’diel’s ecosystems who reads a creature’s lineage and guides companions toward its natural vulnerability.
souls.summary: Identify your quarry’s physical weakness and ask your tracker to open it up for your party’s regular attacks.

highlights: Grants Dual Wield, DEX/CHR, Attack, Accuracy, and Crit Rate scaling.
Dagger/Sword hits build Cadence; Weapon Skills unleash Sonic follow-up damage + Encore.
Unlocks Lunge & Flourish (20s) and Troubadour's Encore (45s) without overwriting buffs.
souls.lore: A dashing blade-dancer of the open road who weaves twin-steel flourishes into vibrant, echoing melodies.
souls.summary: Wandering troubadour spec: Dual-wield Dagger/Sword DPS with Cadence stacks, Sonic WS follow-ups, and Encore haste.

highlights: Threnodies, Requiems, Elegies, and Finale deal CHR + MAB magic damage and can Magic Burst.
Offensive songs never overwrite your Ballad/Scherzo party buffs.
Unlocks Grand Finale (20s Resonance burst) and Lyrical Overdrive (45s).
souls.lore: A concert virtuoso of Vana’diel’s ancient harmonies whose dramatic crescendos both uplift companions and shatter foes with sound.
souls.summary: Tavnazian lyrical mage spec: Turns Threnodies, Requiems, and Elegies into fast-cast elemental nukes that can Magic Burst.

highlights: Lullabies, Elegies, Requiems, and Finale generate heavy pre-nerf Volatile & Cumulative Enmity.
Passively empowers Minne (PDT), Paeon (Regen), and Scherzo (tank-buster dampening) without re-casting.
Unlocks Dissonant Chord (15s snap taunt) and Iron Aria (45s mitigation & sonic reflect).
souls.lore: A defiant troubadour whose resonant chords and iron-willed ballads command the attention of titans while fortifying their own spirit.
souls.summary: Homage to the pre-nerf Lv.75 BRD tank: Uncapped enmity on Lullaby/Elegy/Requiem, Minne/Paeon aura mastery, and Scherzo survival.

highlights: Sightline Shot fires one projectile after three seconds of aim (20y, 12-second recast). It works from Lv.10.
Sightline Shot gains +10/20/20/30 Ranged Accuracy at Lv.10/30/50/70+ and deals 2.0x at Lv.10 or 2.3x from Lv.30.
Deep Sight (Lv.50+) trades four seconds of aim for 2.8x damage, increasing to 3.2x at Lv.70.
Moving beyond one yalm, losing your firing lane, changing engaged target, or being incapacitated cancels aim. Cancellations spend no ammo and have a three-second retry.
souls.lore: A dead-eyed marksman of quiet patience who claims a clear sightline and lets a single, unerring shot speak across the horizon.
souls.summary: A deliberate marksman who commits to one high-precision shot with a gun or crossbow.

highlights: Lv.10 QoL: Auto-equips Crossbow & Bolts if empty, 100% Ammo Recycle, zero ranged distance penalty; +12/16/20/25% HP, +15/25/35/50 Archery/Marksmanship, +12/20/28/38 RACC, +15/22/30/40% Snapshot/Rapid Shot, +8/12/16/22 Store TP with active pet.
Warden's Ration: Ranged WSs heal your active beast for 15/18/20/22% Beast Max HP and grant +250 Pet TP.

Glacial Tusker (Wild Raaz Lv.10+ / Cehuetzi Lv.75): Tier 6 -60% DMG Dealt (0.12x WS, 0.25x Pet Mobskill), +40..70% Pet HP, -30% Pet DT, 100% AoE/Conal immunity, +60..120 Pet Enmity, 100% Master->Pet enmity transfer & 80% Cure (+100% overheal) forwarding.
Volcanic Saurian (Stalker Raptor Lv.10+ / Gabbrath Lv.75): Tier 2 Hybrid -25% DMG Dealt (0.50x WS) + -25 Enmity, 15y Party Pack Aura (+8..20 ACC/RACC & +8..15% ATK/RATK).
100% Single-Target JAs: Rimetusk Gore, Saurian Rend, Primeval Takedown.
souls.lore: A frontier tracker bonded to a fierce wild companion, directing primal loyalty from the thick of the hunt to hold the wilderness at bay.
souls.summary: Modal Pet-Tank & Pack Ranger who bonds with Glacial Tuskers (Wild Raaz / Cehuetzi) to anchor bosses or Volcanic Saurians (Stalker Raptor / Gabbrath) to empower party offense.

highlights: Attunement Arrow works from Lv.10. A landed bow shot marks one enemy for 10/12/12/14 seconds at Lv.10/30/50/70+.
The first matching party spell or skillchain gains 12/15/18/20% damage at Lv.10/30/50/70+.
A solo Arcane Archer can claim its own mark with an elemental bow weapon skill at half the bonus.
One live mark per archer and per enemy. Misses spend one arrow and start the recast without replacing a mark.
souls.lore: A mystic fletching artisan who inscribes elemental resonance onto every arrow, painting luminous marks for allies to awaken.
souls.summary: Select one of six elements and land an arrow to amplify one coordinated allied follow-up.

highlights: Open weapon choice; requires Great Katana for Ronin passives, Stagger, and JA upgrades.
Unlocks Seigan, Third Eye (15s CD, 2-3 Mind's Eye charges), Meditate, and Blade Bash at Lv.10+.
Mind's Eye anticipates melee swings and single-target mob TP moves, countering for +60 TP & high Enmity.
Mushin Poise defers 25-30% of hit damage into a 9s Stagger pool, purified by Tachi WSs, Blade Bash, and Meditate.
Warding Circle (120s CD) grants party -8% DT & +15 MEVA; Meikyo Shisui grants -20% DT & instant Mind's Eye.
souls.lore: A wandering master of the great katana whose serene clarity absorbs terrible blows with stoic grace before shedding their weight.
souls.summary: Masterless Mushin tank: requires a Great Katana to unlock Seigan mitigation, multi-charge Mind's Eye counter-anticipation, and Mushin Stagger damage deferral purified by Tachis, Meditate, and Blade Bash.

highlights: Open weapon choice; equipping a Bow grants A+ Archery skill, 100% Recycle (0 arrows used), +R.Acc/R.Atk/Snapshot.
Auto-attacks with Bow + Arrow up to 20y outside melee range and suffers zero point-blank Bow penalty.
Oisoya Shot (25s CD, 20y): ranged piercing arrow that restores +200-350 TP, primes Chainbound, and grants Drawn Oisoya & Cosmic Brand.
Tachi WS -> Drawn Oisoya (+TP Bonus, +WSD, +R.Atk%, +125 TP refund on next Archery WS); Archery WS -> Cosmic Brand (+TP Bonus, +WSD, +SC Dmg on next Tachi).
Hasso works with Bow or Great Katana (+Snapshot, +R.Atk%, +R.Acc, +AGI); Sengikori & Meikyo empower Bow + Blade chains.
souls.lore: A noble retainer of Far Eastern courtly arms who bridges distant bowcraft and drawing-blade mastery in a single unbroken cadence.
souls.summary: Tenzen-inspired Bow & Great Katana skirmisher: raises Archery to A+ with 100% arrow preservation, auto-shoots up to 20y outside melee, and weaves Tachi <-> Archery WSs via Drawn Oisoya and Cosmic Brand.

highlights: Open weapon choice; requires Great Katana for +Accuracy, +Store TP, +Zanshin, +Subtle Blow, and Iaijutsu support effects.

Hagakure (20s CD): sheathes into Noto stance (15s), turning your next Tachi into an Iaijutsu Draw-Slash (+35..100% Crit, +250..600 TP Bonus, Save TP, Chainbound) inflicting Onimaru Sundering (-15% DEF, -10% MDEF, -25 EVA for 15s).
Ashura's Edge (up to 3x, 20s): 15y party aura (+10/16/24% Subtle Blow, +6/10/15% WSD, +8/14/20 Acc/MAcc, +8/12/16 Regain); at 3 stacks melee swings restore +15 HP & +5 MP to party within 15y.
Onimaru Blood-Quench: closing a Skillchain boosts SC damage by +20-35% and restores 10% Max HP, 8% Max MP, and +250 TP to party within 15y.
Onimaru Tithe (25s CD, 15y, 12s): grants party +350 TP, +12% WSD, and +15% Lifesteal, and refreshes Ashura's Edge to 3 stacks.

Support Tradeoff & JAs: -20% Atk% & -15% WSD; Hasso shares 50% STR/Acc/Haste (15y); Meditate grants +1,500 TP self / +400 TP party; Sekkanoki grants party +15% Crit (12s); Meikyo Shisui grants 3x Ashura, 0s Hagakure CD, and 2x Blood-Quench.
souls.lore: A commanding shogunate champion whose decisive bladework kindles an inspiring martial aura across every warrior at their side.
souls.summary: Cursed Onimaru & Iaijutsu battlefield support (Lv10+): keeps the aggressive Great Katana & 20s Hagakure Sheathe-and-Draw playstyle while channeling Ashura's Edge stacks and Onimaru Blood-Quench Skillchains into party-wide TP/HP/MP surges, enemy armor sundering, and party-wide Subtle Blow.

highlights: Tier 1 Damage: PHYS_DMG_DEALT, MAG_DMG_DEALT, and RANGED_DMG_DEALT remain at 0 (full DPS scaling).

Shadow Squadron (Utsusemi Ichi @ Lv10 / Ni @ Lv37): Summons 2 or 3 offensive shadow clones (max 5 active, 25-30s lifetime, up to 170 HP at Lv75, zero defensive shadows) that copy your appearance and independently attack your engaged target.

Feint -> Switch -> Cascade Tactical Cycle: 2 distinct living clones landing verified hits within 6s establish Feint Ready (20s). Issue varied squad commands (False Assault, Mirror Step, Crosscut, Shadow Pin, Thunder Relay, Final Mirage, Shadow Legion, Phantom Assault) to advance Feint -> Switch -> Cascade and unleash a capped coordinated strike.

Squad Commands (Zero-Tool Ninjutsu): False Assault (Lv10, 12s CD: feint + 12s Opening for +25% next different command), Mirror Step (Lv10, 16s CD: 10s alternating fast/heavy cadence scaling with squad size), Crosscut (Lv10, 14s CD: rapid single-target clone strikes), Shadow Pin (Lv30, 18s CD: 12s target lock +ACC/+melee & phase extension), Thunder Relay (Lv50, 22s CD: escalating sequential relay for 2+ clones), Final Mirage (Lv70, 45s CD: high-commitment phase-consuming finisher).
Custom JAs (Lv10+): Shadow Legion (90s CD: staggered full-squad burst) and Phantom Assault (30s CD, 8s: -25% attack interval for living clones) integrate directly into the tactical cycle.
souls.lore: A shadowy master of forbidden duplication who surrounds their quarry with a fleeting retinue of striking mirror-selves.
souls.summary: Tier 1 Pure Physical DPS Ninja (Lv10+, Katana): shadow-clone commander that fields up to 5 offensive shadow clones via Shadow Squadron Ichi/Ni and sequences squad commands through a Feint -> Switch -> Cascade tactical cycle.

highlights: Dual Katana & Ninjutsu Mastery: +15/25/35/50 Katana & Ninjutsu skill, +15/22/30/38 Subtle Blow, -20/30/40/50% Ninjutsu Cast Time, 100% SIRD, and 0 Ninja Tool consumption.

Shadow Economy & Kawarimi Ash: Ichi (3 shadows, 1.5s/18s) & Ni (4 shadows, 1.2s/28s) overwrite cleanly; broken shadows grant +35 TP, VE, Shadow Smoke (-4% ATTP/MATT, -6 ACC/stack, max 4), and +1 Kawarimi Ash; AoEs consume max 2 shadows w/ 50% bleedthrough.

Katana WS Sustain & Custom JAs: Katana WSs refresh Shadow Smoke & spend 3 Ash for +1 shadow + 8/10/12/14% HP; Kage Bunshin (45s CD: +3 shadows, 1 cleanse, -15% MDT 6s); Smoke Lotus (30s CD: 4x Shadow Smoke, 20% Slow, +2 Ash).

Tank JAs: Yonin (15s CD: +30 Enmity, +25 MACC, -18% DT & +15% Parry at 0 shadows); Futae (45s CD: instant Ninjutsu, 2.5x VE, 2s Stun, Expose -25 MEVA); Mijin Gakure (120s CD: 12s Migawari intercept negating >30% HP hits, +25% HP, +4 shadows).
souls.lore: A phantom body-double of drifting ash and lantern smoke who bewilders foes with shifting decoys and vanishing silhouettes.
souls.summary: Decoy-detonating shadow & ninjutsu tank (Lv10+, Dual Katanas): unlocks zero-tool Ninjutsu & Utsusemi Ichi/Ni @ Lv10+, converts broken shadows into Kawarimi Ash & Shadow Smoke, and intercepts tankbusters with Migawari.

highlights: Severing Seal can interrupt enemy spells with a full landing. If the spell completes, its direct damage is reduced by 8/10/10/12%.
Blunting Seal reduces physical damage from one enemy technique by 10/13/13/16%.
Both seals work from Lv.10, share a 20-second recast (18 at Lv.50+), and retry in 3 seconds on a mismatch.
Quick Read unlocks at Lv.30 and shortens the next seal cast during its eight-second window.
souls.lore: A vigilant watcher of the unseen clan who reads an enemy’s smallest tell and seals away looming danger with swift hand-signs.
souls.summary: React to enemy telegraphs with a seal that disrupts one hostile spell or weakens one physical move.

highlights: Spineshatter Vault works from Lv.10 between 4 and 12 yalms. Land at a safe spot near the target and strike once.
Short lanes deal 1.6x normalized damage. Long lanes over 7 yalms deal 2.2/2.5/2.5/2.8x at Lv.10/30/50/70+.
Blocked lanes spend three seconds of recast without moving or dealing damage.
From Lv.50, a landed long vault powers the next Piercing Jump against the same enemy for five seconds.
souls.lore: A fearless spearhead who measures the open ground and surges across the battlefield in a devastating vaulted charge.
souls.summary: A polearm specialist whose long, clear launch lanes give stronger vault strikes and a jump follow-through.

highlights: Grounding Cry challenges one enemy from up to 15 yalms for 200 CE and 700 VE (16-second recast).
Skyward Guard protects against one direct enemy hit during its 1.5-second window. Mitigation scales to 35/40/45/50%.
Guard landing adds 100 CE and 300 VE to the original living target. A successful intercept grants a 5/8/10% max-HP ward from Lv.30.
Guard and ward leave targetability and current hate intact. Scripted HP changes bypass both.
souls.lore: A proud lance-knight of the high crags who takes to the wind at the decisive heartbeat, descending with thunderous presence to command the field.
souls.summary: A polearm tank who opens with an enmity challenge and times a short guard without leaving melee.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% Max HP, +10/16/22/28 VIT/MND/STR, +20/28/36/45% Cure/Breath Potency, +15/20/25/30% Subtle Blow, +15/25/35/50 Polearm, +10/14/18/22% Parry (Inquartata), -25/35/45/60 Enmity; Wyvern +40/50/60/75% HP, -40% DT, -60 Enmity & 100% AoE Breath/Magic resist.

Lv.10+ Kit & Polearm Triage: Unlocks Call Wyvern (15s CD, in-combat, 100% HP), Jump, High Jump, Spirit Link, and Restoring Breath @ Lv.10+ (Super Jump @ Lv.50+); Polearm WSs command Wyvern Crimson Triage (18/21/24/28% DRG Max HP on lowest-HP ally + overheal -> 12% Stoneskin) + 1 Wyrmscale (max 3).

Distinct Jump Directives & Spirit Link: Jump (20s CD, +150 TP, +1 Wyrmscale, 2 lowest-HP allies Hybrid Regen 15 + 2.2% Max HP/t + 1 Erase); High Jump (35s CD, +1 Wyrmscale, 15y 2-debuff party cleanse + 10% Stoneskin); Spirit Link (15s CD, 0 HP cost, 22/25/28/32% single-target heal + 2 Erase + 40% Wyvern HP + 1 Wyrmscale).

Restoring Breath & Super Jump: Restoring Breath (20s CD) spends 0..3 Wyrmscale for 14/20/26/32% DRG Max HP party heal (3 stacks -> 15% Dragonscale Stoneskin); Super Jump (75s CD) wipes enmity, hides Wyvern 8s, and grants 3 Wyrmscale (Spirit Surge halves Jump CDs & +2 Wyrmscale).

Wyrmblood Pulse (45s CD, 24% DRG Max HP party heal + 2-debuff cleanse + resets Jump/High Jump) & Dragonscale Sanctuary (75s CD, 15s: 15% Max HP Stoneskin, Knockback Immune & shared Ward -12% DMG / +30 MEVA).
souls.lore: A dragon-bonded guardian whose kinship with a living wyvern channels soaring vitality and restorative breath to allies in peril.
souls.summary: Pure martial Dragon-Blood Lancer & Wyvern Triage Healer (Lv10+, Polearm): unlocks Call Wyvern, Jumps, Spirit Link, and Restoring Breath @ Lv10+, weaves Wyrmscale stacks into scaled AoE Healing Breaths, and commands Wyvern Crimson Triage on Polearm WSs.

highlights: Lv.10: Call Carbuncle or Ifrit and use Challenge Aspect with its single-target elemental pact.
Lv.30: Pick two additional primes. Lv.50: All seven avatars are available.
Challenges empower matching pacts by 20/25/30/35% for the least resisted element. The window lasts 12 seconds, or 15 from Lv.70.
souls.lore: An avatar-channeler attuned to the shifting elements who invokes celestial fury when the winds of elemental allegiance align.
souls.summary: Commit an avatar’s element to a single target and exploit the enemy’s weakest elemental resistance.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% HP & MP, +12/18/24/32 MND & CHR, +18/26/34/42% Cure & Ward Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +5/8/11/15 MP/tick Refresh, -100% Avatar Perpetuation.
Astral Avatar Resonance: Summoned Avatar projects Celestial Sanctuary (15y): 12/16/20/24 + 1.5% Max HP/t Regen, +4/6/8/10 MP/t Refresh, -10% DT.
Ward-Loop & Starlight Mend: Blood Pact: Ward has a flat 12s recast (6s Apogee); Wards and Staff/Club WSs heal Avatar 50% HP and pulse 15% Max HP party heal.
JA Enhancements: Elemental Siphon (20s CD, 45% MP without dismissing Avatar + 20% AoE heal) & Astral Flow (5s Ward CD, 25% Stoneskin).
Astral Benediction (22s CD, 32% HP AoE heal + 3-debuff cleanse + Reraise III) & Celestial Convergence (25s CD, 12s -18% DT + +30 MEVA + 10% MP per Ward/WS).
souls.lore: A serene pact-keeper who calls down starlit avatars to weave tranquil sanctuaries of comfort and celestial grace.
souls.summary: Astral Avatar Conduit, Sanctuary & Ward-Reset Healer (Lv10+): projects a 15y Celestial Sanctuary aura from your Avatar, resets Blood Pact: Ward to 12s (6s in Apogee / 5s in Astral Flow), and pulses Starlight Mend on Wards and WSs.

highlights: Lv.10: Invite Carbuncle or Ifrit, cast Astral Accord and follow through with the avatar’s response.
Astral Accord snapshots party members within 15 yalms, costs 8% Max MP and recasts in 30 seconds.
One matching direct elemental hit per member. Pets share their master’s claim. The bonus scales to 8/10/10/12%.
Shiva and Garuda open at Lv.30. Titan, Leviathan and Ramuh open at Lv.50. The window extends from 8 to 10 seconds at Lv.70.
souls.lore: A voice of the astral accords who announces an avatar’s elemental chorus, uniting allies in a shared symphony of planar power.
souls.summary: Invite a party to follow your avatar’s element. Each member has a separate opportunity to strengthen one matching hit.

highlights: Assess Prey identifies all tied least-resistant categories available at your level for eight seconds.
Matching direct Blue spells gain 12/15/18/20% damage after resistance at Lv.10/30/50/70+.
Three physical categories unlock at Lv.10. The elemental category unlocks at Lv.50.
Soul magic is single-target and automatically available. The saved Blue Magic set is restored on leaving Warmage.
souls.lore: A calculating student of bestial lore who curates an arsenal of stolen monster arts to answer any foe’s defenses.
souls.summary: Read one enemy and select the monster technique that best answers its defenses.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): Dual Wield @ Lv10+ (+15/20/25/30% DW), +12/16/20/25% HP & MP, +10/16/22/28 MND & INT, +18/26/34/42% Cure Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +4/6/8/12 MP/tick Refresh, 100% SIRD in Diffusion/Unbridled.
Azure Mending & AoE Diffusion: Healing Blue Magic splashes to all party members within 15y at 85% potency.
Sanguine Catalyst: Dual-wield hits stack Azure Catalyst (max 5); at 5 stacks or on Sword/Club WS, unleashes Azure Mending Wave (12/16/20/24% Max HP AoE heal + 6% Max MP).
JA Enhancements: Diffusion (20s CD) & Azure Lore (doubles Azure Mending Wave heals).
White Wind Surge (20s CD, 28% HP AoE heal + 2-debuff cleanse + 15% Stoneskin) & Osmotic Conduit (25s CD, 12s -10% MDT + 3% HP / 2% MP party siphon per swing).
souls.lore: A twin-bladed alchemist of azure essence whose fluid strikes and esoteric chants ripple outward in waves of renewal.
souls.summary: Azure Alchemist, Dual-Wielding Siphon-Healer & Blue Magic Mender (Lv10+): splashes Blue Magic heals across the party, builds Azure Catalyst on dual-wield hits/WSs, and links blades to allies via Osmotic Conduit.

highlights: Early Dual Wield & Mastery: Unlocks Dual Wield at Lv.10+ (-15/20/25/30% delay), +15/25/35/50 Sword/Club/Blue skill, +14/20/26/32% Parry, +20/30/40/50% Fast Cast, and 100% SIRD.

Monster-Core Carapace: Physical Blue Magic (Head Butt, Sudden Lunge, Bludgeon, Smite of Rage, Heavy Strike, Goblin Rush) deals 3x VE, costs -30% MP, and grants Chitin Carapace (max 5: +4% DEF & -3% DT each for 15s); Defensive spells gain +35% potency & +6% Max MP at 3+ stacks.
Azure Assimilation: Sword/Club WS grants Azure Surge (6s) making your next Blue Magic spell instant-cast, 0 MP, with an AoE 8y volatile enmity pulse.
Tradeoff & JAs (-20% ATK/RATK, -15% WSD): Enhances Burst Affinity (heavy VE + -15% MATK Down), Chain Affinity (3s Stun + 20% Max HP barrier), and Azure Lore (-25% DT, +50 Enmity, -50% Blue Magic MP).
souls.lore: An Immortal sentinel who tempers body and spirit with assimilated monstrous resilience, adapting their carapace to every peril.
souls.summary: Monster-forged frontliner (Lv10+): grants early Dual Wield at Lv.10+, 100% Spell Interruption Rate Down, Monster-Core Carapace mitigation, and physical Blue Magic threat & barrier weaving.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+, Gun): +15/22/30/40% R.Atk & M.Atk, +20/30/40/50% Snapshot & Rapid Shot, +10/14/18/22% Ranged Crit, +15/25/35/50 Marksmanship, -15/20/25/35 Enmity.
Deadeye Chamber (Phantom Roll, 15s CD, self-only): +15/20/25/30% Ranged/Magic WS DMG & +15% Ranged Crit DMG for 30s.
Powder Mark (Quick Draw, 10s charge, 2 charges): marks target for 10s; Marksmanship WS detonates +20% elemental dmg & refunds +150 TP.
Crystal JAs: Hair Trigger (30s CD, +30% Snapshot & +25% WS DMG / -15% DEF), Broadside Salvo (22s CD, 20y single-target 2.0-3.2x shot, +250 TP, +1 QD charge).
souls.lore: A relentless gunslinger of sea-salt and smoke who unleashes disciplined volleys of blazing shot across the deck.
souls.summary: Tier 1 Pure Damage Corsair spec (Lv10+): Deadeye Chamber, Powder Mark Quick Draw detonations, zero self-healing, and 100% Bullet/Card recycle.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +12/16/20/25% HP/MP, +12/18/24/32 AGI/CHR, +25/35/45/55% Roll Potency & +50% Duration, 3 active rolls, -20/25/30/40 Enmity.
High-Roller Stakes: Rolls 1-10 have Roll 8-9 Safe Standing; Lucky & XI clear Bust and pulse +150 TP & +8% MP (15y).
Random Deal (35s CD, 15y) shaves -12s off standard party JAs (excludes 1hrs/Wild Card/Random Deal/Dead Man's Hand); Quick Draw shaves -3s & applies Expose.
Crystal JAs: House Advantage (30s CD, forced XI + 15y Offense), Dead Man's Hand (35s CD, single-target 2x Dispel + Breach, -10s party JAs, +200 TP on Lucky/XI).
souls.lore: A daring fortune-weaver of ivory dice and phantom cards who steadies the crew’s luck while flirting with audacious wagers.
souls.summary: Tier 3 Pure Support Corsair spec (Lv10+): High-Roller Stakes with Safe Standing (Roll 8-9 floor), 150% Overdrive on Lucky/XI, 3 active rolls, Card Counting Quick Draw, and 100% Bullet/Card recycle.

highlights: Galleon's Roll (20s CD, self-only): -12% DT, +20% DEF, +25 Enmity for 60s.
Point-Blank Pistol (1H Sword WS): strictly single-target enmity blast, heals 8/10/12/14% Max HP, +1 Grapeshot (max 3); Quick Draw consumes Grapeshot for 6%/stack Stoneskin + utility.
Crystal JAs: Grapeshot Broadside (25s CD, single-target 12y enmity + Blind + Slow + 2 Grapeshot), Iron Hull (45s CD, -18% DT, Knockback Immunity, 20% heal + cleanse).
souls.lore: A swaggering cutlass-and-pistol privateer who thrives at point-blank range, turning black-powder bravado into hardened resolve.
souls.summary: Tier 6 Pure Tank Corsair spec (Lv10+): requires 1H Sword + Gun (optional Buckler or 12% Pistol-Guard block), single-target Point-Blank Pistol WSs, Salt-Spray Stoneskin, and 100% Bullet/Card recycle.

highlights: Single-Target Valoredge AI: Strobe (12s CD Provoke + -20 ACC Blind), Shield Bash (18s CD 2s NM-safe Stun), Cannibal Blade (20% Auto Max HP heal + VE), Ventriloquy (20s CD swap + 25% VE + -18% DT 8s).

H2H WS & Repair: H2H WSs heal Valoredge 18% HP, grant Master 10% Alloy Plating Stoneskin (12s) & inflict EFF_OX_DEB_CRIPPLE; Repair (25s CD, 0 oil) heals Valoredge 50% + Master 18% + 1-debuff cleanse.
Custom JAs: Clockwork Bulwark (35s CD, 12s 50% hit split reduced by 25%, -15% DT & Knockback Immunity) & Hydraulic Slam (22s CD, ST 6y strike + 2s Stun + EFF_OX_DEB_BREACH).
souls.lore: A master artisan commanding an armored Valoredge automaton, directing clockwork valor to stand immovable before towering foes.
souls.summary: Pure Valoredge Automaton Tank (Lv10+, H2H): forces Valoredge Head+Frame, 100% Overload Immunity, single-target Strobe/Shield Bash/Cannibal Blade tanking, Ventriloquy hate swap, Clockwork Bulwark 50% split, and Hydraulic Slam.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% Max HP, +10/16/22/28 MND/VIT/DEX, +18/26/34/42% Cure & Repair Potency, +15/20/25/30% Subtle Blow, +10/14/18/22% Guard, +15/25/35/50 H2H & Auto Melee/Magic, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, 100% Overload Immunity.

Automaton Medic (Harlequin/Stormwaker/Soulsoother): +40/50/60/75% HP/MP, -35% DT, +40/50/60/70% Fast Cast, +6/9/12/16 MP/t Refresh, -60 Enmity, 100% AoE/Breath resist, and built-in Cure I-V, Erase & -na White Magic @ Lv10+.

Maneuver Directives (10s shared CD): Light (16/19/22/25% single-target mend + 15/30/45% Cure splash), Water (+12% Auto MP, 1 Erase + 12y Hybrid Regen mist), Earth (12% Stoneskin + Cure overheal -> 18% Stoneskin).

H2H Synchronized Overclock: H2H WSs restore +10% Auto MP, shave -4s Auto recasts, grant +1 Aether Cell (max 3), and fire Light/Water/Earth pulses; Repair (30s CD, 0 oil, 50% Auto HP/MP + 12s Hybrid Regen); Ventriloquy/Cooldown (30s CD, -40% Enmity + 1 Cell).
Aether Overhaul (45s CD, spends 0..3 Cells for 16/21/26/31% party+pet heal, 2-3 cleanse & Auto reset) & Clockwork Aegis (75s CD, 15s: 18% Stoneskin + shared Ward -12% DMG / +30 MEVA).
souls.lore: A compassionate alchemist-mechanic who guides a restorative automaton with subtle elemental signals to mend and shelter allies.
souls.summary: Pure martial Automaton Medic & Tactical Maneuver Healer (Lv10+, Hand-to-Hand): unlocks Activate, Repair, Ventriloquy, Cooldown, and Light/Water/Earth Maneuvers @ Lv10+ with built-in Automaton White Magic, 0% Overload, and H2H Synchronized Overclock.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+, H2H): +15/22/30/38% Master & Pet ATK/RATK, +10/15/20/25% Martial Arts/DA & Pet Haste, +8/12/16/20% Crit Rate, +15/25/35/50 H2H & Auto Melee/Ranged, -15/20/25/35 Enmity, 100% Overload Immunity.
Tandem Combo Loop: H2H WSs grant +350 Pet TP & 8s single-target Tandem Opening (+25% damage on String Shredder/Armor Shatterer/Arcuballista/Bone Crusher & +3s Skillchain window).

Custom JAs: Tandem Barrage (25s CD, ST 6y strike, +300 TP both, -15% DEF 10s) & Limiter Release (35s CD, 12s +22% ATK/RATK, +15% DA/Rapid Shot, -15% DEF); Overdrive grants +50 Store TP & 0s Maneuver CDs.
souls.lore: A kinetic fighter who boxes in tight synchronization with a finely tuned frame, turning master and machine into a seamless duo.
souls.summary: Pure Tandem DPS (Lv10+, H2H): Valoredge/Sharpshot Automaton with 0% post-damage penalty, +350 Pet TP & Tandem Opening on H2H WSs, Tandem Barrage, and Limiter Release.

highlights: Crimson Drain Samba: Party (15y) heals for 18/24/30/36% of physical damage dealt; overhealing converts into Crimson Veil Stoneskin (up to 20% Max HP).
Sanguine Flourish: Steps grant +2 FM & 10% party heal; Dagger/Throwing WSs consume up to 5 FM for 6%/FM AoE heal + party cleanse.
JA Enhancements: Trance (0 TP Waltzes, infinite FMs, 2x Drain Samba) & Contradance (15s CD, +100% Waltz & -15% DT 10s).
Sanguine Waltz (18s CD, 200 TP: 30% HP AoE heal + 2-debuff cleanse + 25 + 3.5% Max HP/t Regen) & Nocturne Feast (25s CD: drains 15% foe HP into party HP + 250 TP + 5 FMs).
souls.lore: A velvet-cloaked reveler of crimson waltzes who siphons vitality from the heat of combat to sustain every partner on the floor.
souls.summary: Crimson Blood-Dancer, Lifesteal Waltz & Sanguine Step Healer (Lv10+, 0-MP TP/FM Engine): converts physical damage into party Drain Samba lifesteal & Crimson Veil barriers, and detonates Finishing Moves on Dagger/Throwing WSs.

highlights: Auto-attacks with equipped chakram when outside melee range.
Throwing Stance (JA): overrides melee auto-attacks with chakram throws at all ranges.
Unlocks 12 custom Dancer Throwing weaponskills (Lv 5-75).
Steps and offensive Flourishes work up to 20 yalms.
Drain, Aspir, and Haste Samba trigger on ranged chakram hits.
Passive +R.Acc, +R.Atk, +Snapshot, +AGI, and +CHR.
souls.lore: An acrobatic skirmisher of spinning chakrams who keeps the rhythm of the dance alive from beyond the crush of steel.
souls.summary: Ranged chakram spec: auto-attacks with your chakram when out of melee range (or at all ranges with Throwing Stance), unlocks 12 Throwing weaponskills, and lets Steps, Flourishes, and Sambas work at range.

highlights: Dual Dagger Mastery: Dual Wield (-15/20/25/30% delay), +12/16/20/24% Parry Rate, +15/20/25/30 Subtle Blow, +15/25/35/50 Dagger & Parrying.
Fan Dance Rhythm (15s CD, does not lock Waltzes): -30% Phys/Mag DT (decays 5%/hit, floor -10%); Dagger WSs restore +10% & +1 FM.
Steps (5s CD, 0 TP): +2 FMs, snap enmity, EFF_OX_DEB_CRIPPLE (-5% ATTP/MATT & -7 ACC/stack, max 3); Flourishes grant 3% Max HP/FM Stoneskin + cleanse.
Pirouette Deflect (40s CD, Self 8s) & Dazzling Cadence (25s CD, Single-Target 6y): reset Fan Dance, +20% Parry + Knockback Immunity; 2s Stun + Blind + Slow + 3 FMs.
souls.lore: A mesmerizing troupe-guardian whose whirling twin daggers and fan-lit footwork lure strikes into graceful, dazzling deflections.
souls.summary: Acrobatic frontline dancer tank (Lv10+): requires Dual Daggers to unlock Fan Dance Rhythm (recharged by Dagger WSs), Aegis Waltz Stoneskin, and single-target Step/Cadence wards.

highlights: Unlocks Call Eos faerie companion (auto -na/Erase & stackable Regen).
Addendum: White lasts 2 hours.
Sublimation charges 2x faster with no HP drain.
Cure & Regen spells gain free 10y Accession AoE without Stratagem cost.
souls.lore: A field-academy physician guided by luminous grimoires and a gentle fae companion, tending weary ranks with calm precision.
souls.summary: Light Arts spec: Call Eos faerie companion, safer Sublimation, and automatic Accession for Cure and Regen spells.

highlights: Unlocks Call Titania dark faerie companion (enfeebling & elemental nuking).
Addendum: Black lasts 2 hours.
Permanent Ebullience active for black magic.
Helix damage +50% and Helix duration extended to 2 hours.
Magic Attack Bonus +30 and elemental spells bypass 10% target MEVA.
souls.lore: A learned elemental theorist accompanied by a fierce fae spirit, inscribing enduring arcane equations across protracted battles.
souls.summary: Dark Arts spec: Call Titania dark faerie companion, permanent Ebullience, stronger Helix spells, and improved elemental casting.

highlights: Record watches for 12 seconds and stores exact enemy actions for 60 seconds. One slot at Lv.10 and two from Lv.50.
File Countermeasure protects one target against the exact recorded action for 20 seconds (25 at Lv.70+).
Protection scales to 20/25/25/30%. When multiple pages match, only the strongest applies.
Index Pages unlocks at Lv.50 to choose between two live records. Margin Note provides single-target earth damage.
souls.lore: A meticulous chronicler of monster lore who studies a foe’s signature habits and drafts tailored countermeasures on the parchment of battle.
souls.summary: Observe one enemy, record an exact hostile action, and prepare a specific countermeasure for an ally.

highlights: Lv.10: Lay Meridian and step 3–15 yalms from your anchor to form a corridor granting +12 ACC and MACC.
The corridor is two yalms from the segment center and within three vertical yalms of its interpolated height.
Lv.30: Meridian Shift moves the anchor without extending duration. Scale to +20/+28/+35 ACC and MACC.
Lv.50: Radius becomes 2.5 yalms. Lv.70: Lifetime increases from 30 to 40 seconds. Only the strongest covering corridor applies.
souls.lore: A geomantic wayfinder who traces luminous ley-corridors across the terrain, empowering allies who hold the sacred line.
souls.summary: Use your position and a fixed anchor to create a lane of physical and magical accuracy for your party.

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +14/18/22/28% HP & MP, +12/18/24/32 MND & VIT, +18/26/34/42% Cure & Geomancy Potency, +15/25/35/45% Fast Cast, -25/35/45/60 Enmity, +4/6/8/12 MP/tick Refresh, -50% Luopan Drain.
Living Luopan Sanctuary: Luopan pulses Verdant Bloom every 3s (15y): 6/8/10/12% Max HP heal, +15 MP, and overheal Barkskin Stoneskin (cap 25% Max HP).
Sylvan Resonance: Indi/Geo/Cure or Club/Staff WS heals Luopan to 100% HP and triggers Nature's Surge (16% Max HP party heal + 1-debuff cleanse).
JA Enhancements: Life Cycle (15s CD, 0 self-HP loss + 25% party heal) & Bolster (doubles Verdant Bloom).

Verdant Renewal (20s CD, 30% HP AoE heal + 3-debuff cleanse + 25 + 3.5% Max HP/t Regen + 8/t Refresh 15s) & Canopy of the Ancients (25s CD, 12s -18% DT + Knockback Immune + 10% AoE heal per spell/WS).
souls.lore: A gentle steward of living ley-lines who plants blooming luopan sanctuaries where weary travelers gather to be made whole.
souls.summary: Sylvan Luopan Sanctuary, Living Earth-Pulse & Nature's Renewal Healer (Lv10+): pulses 3s Verdant Bloom heals + MP + Barkskin from your Luopan, and triggers Nature's Surge on Indicolure/Geocolure/Cure/Club/Staff WSs.

highlights: Lv.10: Stone Chip establishes claim. Shallow Fault erupts after two seconds. Lv.30: Deep Fault erupts after four.
The fault hits only the original claimed enemy and spawn if it stays within three horizontal and three vertical yalms.
Both faults share an eight-second recast. Invalid placement costs nothing. A successfully armed fault spends its cost even if the quarry moves.
souls.lore: A seismic mystic who listens to the deep pulse beneath the crust, calling forth sudden earthen upheavals along shifting fault lines.
souls.summary: Predict a claimed quarry’s position and erupt a single-target fault beneath it.

highlights: Skills & Passives: Greatsword A+, Elemental Magic A, Enhancing Magic B, +12/20/28/36 MAB, +8/14/20/28 MACC; one Rune Enchantment fills all unlocked slots (1/2/3 at Lv5/35/65).
Rune Edge: First landed normal Greatsword hit per round deals floor((0.08*GS + 0.04*Enh + 4*Runes) * Delay/480) elemental damage (2x during Overcharge Runes) and builds Conduction (max 3) + MP.
Effusion Slash (Lv10, 20s CD, Enemy 4y): Non-consuming Great Sword arcane strike (1.5x-2.8x +20%/Rune) aligned to newest Rune; can Magic Burst (+35% DMG) and grants +100/150/200/250 TP.
Overcharge Runes (Lv10, 30s CD, Self): 12s overdrive granting +15/22/30/40 MAB, +10/14/18/24% Attack%, +15/20/25/30 MB Bonus, 2x Runic Brand damage, and refreshes active Rune durations.

Magic Spell: Runic Bolt (Lv10, 2.0s cast, 8s CD, 8-24 MP, 10y): High-potency arcane bolt scaling with Elemental Skill, Weapon DMG, INT, STR, Runes (+5%/Rune), & Conduction (+10% DMG, -0.5s cast, -15% MP/stack).

Magic Spell: Runic Sever (Lv55, 3.0s cast, 30s CD, 40 MP, 10y): Heavy arcane finisher scaling with Elemental Skill, Weapon DMG, INT, STR, Runes (+8%/Rune), & Conduction (+12% DMG, -0.5s cast, -15% MP/stack); Magic Bursts.

Edgeflare & Kit: Positive damage from Bolt, Sever, or Effusion Slash grants +25% Rune Edge for 12s (Lv30+); Swordplay (+10 ACC/MACC), Vallation, Gambit (1.10x target element DMG), Runic Ascendance (2hr).
souls.lore: A greatsword-wielding conduit who etches glowing runes along steel, unleashing conducted elemental brilliance in decisive strokes.
souls.summary: Elemental Greatsword spellweaver (Lv10+): Enchanted attacks (Rune Edge), Effusion Slash & Overcharge Runes -> Conduction (up to 3) & MP -> Prepared offensive magic (Runic Bolt / Runic Sever) -> Edgeflare (+25% Rune Edge).

highlights: Passives (Lv10/30/50/70+): +10/18/28/35% Max MP, +2/4/7/10 Refresh, +8/16/25/32 MND & VIT, +12/20/30/35% Cure Potency, +15/25/40/50 Enhancing/Divine/Healing Skill, +10/18/25/30% Fast Cast, -15/25/35/40 Enmity.

Sacred Pulse (Vivacious Pulse at Lv10, 15s CD, Party 12y AoE): Party heal + per-Rune boons (Lux: +25% heal & Regen; Unda: Party debuff cleanse; Tenebrae: Caster MP & Party Refresh; Elemental: 25% Stoneskin).
Font of Life (Lv10, 20s CD, Ally 15y): Restores 22/30/38/48% Max HP, cleanses 2 status ailments, and grants -10/14/18/22% DT & +10/15/20/25% Cure Rcvd for 12s.
Sanctified Ward (Lv10, 35s CD, 15s, Party 12y): Instant 10/14/18/22% Party HP heal + 15s Sanctuary (25 + 3.5% Max HP/tick Regen, -8/12/16/20% DT, +15/25/35/50 MEVA).
Runic Lifetap: Melee hits & WSs while holding Runes mend the most injured party member (2.5-5% HP + 0.5*MND) and restore 1-3% Max MP.

AoE Regen & Wards: Regen I-IV project as 10y Party AoE with +50% potency & +60s duration; One for All (60s CD) also heals the party for 18% of your Max HP; Valiance (60s CD) grants +15% Cure Rcvd & Fast Cast.
souls.lore: A frontline rune-mender who braids living sigils into restorative pulses, renewing embattled allies amid the clash of arms.
souls.summary: Keeper of Sacred Yggdrasil Runes (Lv10+): turns Vivacious Pulse into a 15s CD party AoE heal + rune-driven Regen/Cleanse/Refresh/Stoneskin, and projects AoE Regen spells.

highlights: Parry & Runic Persistence: +12/24/40/50 Parry & Great Sword Skill, +6/10/15/18% Parry Rate (+10% w/ GS); 3 Runes at Lv10+; Swipe/Lunge/Gambit/Rayke preserve Runes & add Enmity.
Runic Riposte: Parrying heals 1.5% Max HP, restores 1% Max MP, grants +50 TP & +Enmity, and deals an elemental counter-slash.
Stance: Iron Battuta (Lv10, 15s CD): +15/22/30/40% Parry Rate, -8/12/16/20% PDT, +15/25/35/50% DEF; swap triggers Steel Flash (+Enmity & 4/6/8/10% HP Stoneskin).
Stance: Runic Aegis (Lv10, 15s CD): -10/15/20/25% MDT/BDT, +20/35/50/70 MEVA, +15/25/35/50 MDEF, +10/15/20/25% Magic Absorb; swap triggers Odyllic Pulse (+Enmity, HP/MP & cleanse).
Runic Convergence (Lv10, 30s CD, 10s): Fuses both stances (-12/16/20/25% DT, +20/30/40/50% Parry, +30/45/60/80 MEVA, +Enmity) and heals 3% HP per Rune.
Tank Tradeoff & JAs: -20% Attack% & -15% WSD; enhances Vallation/Valiance (+10/15/20% DEF), Swordplay (starts at max stacks +15 Enmity), Pflug (-8% PDT), Battuta, and Liement.
souls.lore: A stern sentinel of the Sacred City’s arcane traditions who shifts effortlessly between honed swordplay and shimmering runic wards.
souls.summary: Order of Conscience ward tank (Lv10+): harbors 3 Runes at Lv10+, never loses Runes on Swipe/Lunge/Gambit/Rayke, ripostes on Parry, and weaves short-CD Physical Parry & Elemental Aegis stances.
